strings.멈추시오! 출입 허가증이 없으면 들어갈 수 없습니다!: Halt! You cannot enter without an entry permit!
strings.아무나 들일 수 없는 곳입니다. 아직 탈환군 등록이 필요합니다. 적으로는: We can't let just anyone in. You still need to register with the reclamation force. You don't look like an enemy, but we must verify your identity.
strings.추천장이나 신전의 일원이란 걸 증명할 수 있는 증서가 있으면 보여주시기: If you have a recommendation or a document proving you're a member of the temple, please show it.
strings.죄송합니다. 어떻게 안 될까요?: I'm sorry. Isn't there some way?
strings.사람을 찾고 있어요. 리베라에서 세레스 신전이 있는 곳으로 갔다고 들었거: I'm looking for someone. I heard she left Riveria for the Temple of Seres. Her name is...
strings.저희는 일이 많습니다. 신분이 증명되지 않은 분과 길게 이야기할 시간이: We have much to do. We don't have time for a long conversation with someone whose identity hasn't been verified.
strings.이름만 들어도 알 수 있는 분, 저희가 신뢰할 수 있는 분의 낙인이 찍힌: Please bring a recommendation bearing the seal of someone we know by name and can trust.
Someone who can vouch for me...
Everyone you might know is so far away.
strings.아, 혹시 길드 연합에 계신 분들을 알고 계신가요? 혹시 아인스트 님은요: Oh, do you know anyone in the Guild Union? What about Einst?
strings.아인스트 님이요? 네, 그러면 그분의 추천장을 가지고 오신다면 인정해 드: Einst? Yes. If you bring a recommendation from him, we'll accept it.
Thank you. I'll be back soon.
strings.(아인스트가 %s의 이야기를 듣자마자 의아해하는 표정으로 바라본다.): (As soon as Einst hears %s's story, he looks puzzled.)
strings.오랜만에 무슨 일인가 했더니, 세레스 신전으로 갈 수 있는 추천장이 필요: I wondered what brought you back after so long. You need a recommendation to enter the Temple of Seres? Things are complicated there right now. Demons appeared and attacked the temple.
So the Guild Union members with ties to the temple hurried there. First, I'd like to hear your story. Why did you go to the Temple of Seres?
strings.그런가? 자네가 찾던 소녀가 세레스 님을 만나러 신전으로 갔다고? 그런데: Really? The girl you've been searching for went to the temple to meet Lady Seres? Where did she suddenly appear from?
strings.여태 아무 소식도 없지 않았나? 신전이라니 의외로군. 세레스 님을 만나야: There hadn't been any news of her until now, had there? The temple is unexpected. As for meeting Seres, I wonder whether anyone can even meet the goddess of legend.
I don't know yet, so please write me a recommendation.
Of course. You need to get there first, so I'll write one.
If you join them, it should give them an advantage...
strings.자네가 해결했던 일만 해도 벌써 여럿 아닌가?: Haven't you already resolved quite a few incidents?
strings.어쩌면 그곳에서 자네가 원하는 걸 찾아낼 수 있을지도 몰라. 그러니 자신: Perhaps you'll find what you're looking for there. Don't lose confidence.
But to do that, you may also have to help the reclamation force.
strings.이런 어수선한 시기에 사람을 찾는다고 들어오는 자네가 믿음을 얻으려면 어: In such troubled times, there's no other way for someone arriving to look for a person to earn their trust.
Here. Take a look at this recommendation.
strings.(아인스트는 편지를 만들고 마지막으로 직인을 찍은 뒤 건네주었다.): (Einst finishes the letter, stamps it with his official seal, and hands it over.)
Be sure to remember what I said earlier.
strings.아, 그리고 높아진 명성만큼 자네를 이용하려는 자들도 있겠지. 자네는 사: Oh, and as your reputation grows, there will be people who try to use you. I'm saying this because you're kindhearted and seem unable to refuse.
strings.무슨 말인지 알겠지?: You understand what I mean, don't you?
strings.(추천장을 읽던 에일린이 집중해서 읽다가 %s의 얼굴을 바라본다.): (Aileen reads the recommendation intently, then looks at %s's face.)
Nothing is wrong. You've resolved a great many problems.
strings.생각보다 많은 활약에 조금 놀라서요. 다른 대륙에서 오셔서 길드연합의 일: I'm a little surprised by how much you've accomplished. You came from another continent and helped the Guild Union... Your record is impressive.
Things just turned out that way.
Hmm. Let me look it over once more.
strings.(아인스트 씨가 추천서에다가 많은 걸 써주셨네….): (Einst wrote a lot in that recommendation...)
strings.엄청난 전력이 될테니 믿고 맡겨달라고 하셨네요…. 흠, 전력이라…. 전투: He says you'll be an enormous asset and asks us to trust you... An asset, hmm... I hadn't intended to give you a combat assignment, but I'll report to Tigris.
strings.많은 적들 사이에서 살아남아 임무를 수행하는 것도 무리가 없으시다고 나와: It says you can survive among numerous enemies and complete your mission without difficulty...
strings.아, 방금 허가가 나왔습니다. 저희쪽에서 함께 해주신다면 아낌없이 지원하: Oh, permission has just been granted. If you'll work with us, we'll give you our full support.
Welcome aboard. We look forward to seeing what you can do.
Our commander, Tigris, is in the center of the camp. Please go to him.
(Tigris reads Einst's recommendation, then looks at %s's face again.)
strings.세상에 내가 아인스트 님의 추천장을 다 보게 되는군. 칭찬을 별로 하지: To think I'd see a recommendation from Einst. A man who rarely praises anyone, offering praise like this... Remarkable.
strings.그동안 많은 일을 겪은 것 같은데, 힘들지 않았나?: It seems you've been through a great deal. Has it been difficult?
A lot has happened, but I'm all right now. Thank you for your concern.
strings.그런 걸 가지고 뭘, 저번 용제성 사태 때 크게 활약했다고 들었네. 거기: It's nothing. I heard you played a major role in the recent Dragon Emperor's Palace incident. What on earth happened there...?
strings.내가 알기로 적 대부분이 과거에 천하를 호령했던 용제성의 정규군이었을 텐: As far as I know, most of the enemies were the palace's regular army, which once ruled the land. Were they human? Or...
It's all right. You don't have to tell me everything.
strings.아무튼, 여기까지 오게 된 가장 큰 이유가 뭔가? 자네의 눈에선 명성이나: Anyway, what is the main reason you came all this way? I don't see the desire for fame or riches in your eyes.
I'm looking for a girl named Iris.
strings.(이리스를 찾기 위해 이곳으로 오게됐다며 그 과정을 간단하게 설명한다.): (I briefly explain how my search for Iris brought me here.)
I mean you haven't come to the wrong place.
strings.우리는 얼마 전까지 이리스 님과 함께 있었네. 자네가 찾고 있는 그분이지: Until recently, we were with Lady Iris, the one you're searching for. She knew you would come.
Yes. Our temple's finest are protecting her.
strings.이리스를 보호해주시는 건 알겠지만, 어째서 정예들이 붙어있는 건가요? 다: I understand protecting Iris, but why assign your elite troops to her? Other people at the temple must need protection too...
She is the subject of a divine oracle. I'll leave it at that for now.
strings.이제 자네의 이력을 믿고 맡길테니 우리를 위해 힘을 빌려주게. 이리스 님: Now I'll trust your record and ask you to lend us your strength. For Lady Iris...
strings.프레투스라는 성기사가 신전 내부에 있으니 우선 그를 만나고 일단 그 안에: A paladin named Pretus is inside the temple. Meet him first and hear about the enemies within.
strings.저를 말리러 오신 겁니까? 하지만, 전 이대로 돌아갈 수 없습니다. 교단: Have you come to stop me? I cannot turn back. As the church's gatekeeper, I failed in my duty. I deserve to die.
strings.티그리스 님이 저를 아끼셔도 어쩔 수 없다고 전해주십쇼. 어서 돌아가시기: Tell Tigris that, however much he values me, there is nothing he can do. Please return. This place is dangerous.
This isn't a place just anyone should enter.
strings.아, 그게. 제가 티그리스 님의 부탁을 받고 저 안으로 잠입하려고 하는데: Actually, Tigris asked me to infiltrate the area inside...
strings.티그리스 님께서 프레투스 님께 저 안에 있는 적에 대한 이야기를 들으라고: He told me to ask you about the enemies there.
So you came without knowing anything.
strings.그러니 지금 이곳 상황에 대해 알려 주시겠어요?: Then could you tell me about the situation here?
strings.어느 정도 상황은 알고 있지만, 아무래도 프레투스 님께 듣는게 좋을 것: I know the general circumstances, but I thought it would be best to hear from you.
strings.지휘관께서 보내셨으니 말씀은 드리겠습니다. 신전은 마계의 일족 중 하나: Since the commander sent you, I'll explain. The temple was attacked by a demon force led by one of the demon realm's races, the Dragon Newts.
A Dragon Newt named Blas is called their legion commander and directs the demons.
strings.그들이 이곳에 오게된 건 모두 마계의 군주라 일컬어지는 럭스의 명인 것: It seems they came here on the orders of Lux, who is known as a lord of the demon realm.
strings.그 이름을 알고 계시는군요. 그렇다면 당신은…. 지엔디아 대륙의 용제성,: You know that name. Then you must be... the one who resolved the incidents at the Dragon Emperor's Palace on Jiendia, and at Drulridge and Riveria here...
strings.신전으로 오는 정보엔 당신에 대한 이야기도 있었습니다. 물론, 그 사건도: The information reaching the temple included stories about you. And those incidents, of course.
Lux, lord of the demon realm, and the Agasura...
Anyway, let me explain the temple's situation.
strings.신전을 공격한 마족 무리 중 대다수의 부대가 떠나고 블라스의 군대만이 남: Most of the demon troops that attacked have left, and only Blas's army remains. They seem to be searching for something.
Whatever it is, I cannot forgive these demons and their kind.
strings.많은 이들이 억울하게 당했기 때문에 그들을 위해서라도 절대, 절대로 여기: So many people suffered unjustly. For their sake, I absolutely cannot retreat from here.
strings.프레투스 님, 혹시라도 마족들이 뭘 찾고 계시는지 아시나요?: Pretus, do you have any idea what the demons are looking for?
I'm sorry I know so little...
strings.이곳에 뭔가 중요한 물건이 남아 있나요?: Is there something important left here?
They took all the objects and records containing the goddess Seres's power.
strings.원래 세레스 여신님의 기록은 지엔디아에 남겨져 있어야 하지만, 언제부턴가: Records of the goddess Seres should originally have remained on Jiendia, but at some point they came to be preserved on Freios as well.
Perhaps another god wished to spread the goddess's words.
strings.일단 이곳에 있는 마족들을 정리해야 합니다. 혹시라도 남아있는 생존자가: For now, we must clear out the demons here. If any remaining survivors were to encounter them...
strings.상상도 하기 싫습니다. 부디 저를 도와주셨으면 합니다. 아니, 이건 신을: I don't even want to imagine it. Please help me. This is also work done for our god.
For a god... Ah, yes. I'll do what I can. I'll be going.
...Incredible. You truly possess extraordinary skill. I'm sincerely impressed.
It's selfish of me, but I'd almost like to ask you to keep working for the temple...
That would be too much to ask, wouldn't it?
I'm sorry. I have something I need to do...
strings.거절하셔도 괜찮습니다. 이제 조금 더 접근하는 건 어떨까요? 모험가님이라: It's all right to refuse. Shall we press a little farther now? I think you could face him.
strings.마족 부대를 이끌고 있는 그를 쓰러뜨려야 신전도 다음을 생각할 수 있습니: We can't plan the temple's future until we defeat the one leading these demon troops. Please, adventurer...
It looks dangerous, but I'll try.
strings.네, 모험가님이라면 그런 대답을 주실 줄 알았습니다. 충분히 상대하실 수: Yes. I knew that would be your answer. You should be able to face him.
Subdue Blas as soon as you find him, and find out why he came here.
strings.크, 크큭…. 이런 강한 공격을 받아보는 게 얼마만인지. 그것도 인간에게: Heh... It's been so long since I was struck by such a powerful attack. And from a human, no less...
I have lost. I admit defeat.
strings.어떤 마족은 자신의 패배를 인정할 수 없다면서 온갖 비열한 변명을 하던데: Some demons refuse to accept defeat and make every kind of cowardly excuse...
You look as though there's much you want to know from me, adventurer.
Those eyes remind me of a boy from long ago.
strings.무슨 소리를 하는지 모르겠지만, 내 말에 답했으면 좋겠어: I don't know what you're talking about, but I'd like you to answer me.
strings.너희는 왜 신전을 공격한 거지? 정말로 공격하려고 했다면 이전에도 했어야: Why did you attack the temple? If you truly wanted to attack it, you could have done so before. Why now...?
strings.그리고 이곳에 남아 뭘 찾고 있었던 거지?: And what were you searching for when you stayed behind?
So many questions. There is nothing I can tell you.
Answer me... Now... If you don't, I'll...
strings.큭, 망설이고 있다니 재미있네. 모험가, 네 놈 주위에 냄새가 진동하는군: Heh. You're hesitating. How amusing. There's a stench all around you, adventurer. But this isn't merely the smell of blood from those you've defeated...
strings.날 죽여라, 다른 인간처럼 위선적인 행동을 보이지 말거라. 그렇지 않으면: Kill me. Don't act like a hypocrite, as other humans do. Otherwise, I'll kill you right...
strings.제길. 널 죽일 힘조차 남아있지 않다니. 럭스 님을 위해서라도 그냥 죽을: Damn it. I don't even have the strength left to kill you. For Lord Lux, I will simply die. I will not betray him!!
strings.너에게 럭스가 대체 뭔데 그러는 거야?: What does Lux mean to you that you'd go so far?
Tell me what you know, and I'll consider what to do with you.
If the information is useful, I might... W-wait...
strings.(블라스가 씨익 웃으며 고통스러워하다 점차 사라져간다. 아무래도 럭스에: (Blas grins, writhes in pain, and gradually fades away. He seems to have chosen to destroy himself rather than reveal information about Lux.)
strings.뭐, 뭐하는 거야? 사, 사라지지 말라고!!: W-what are you doing? Don't disappear!!
I need to keep you alive somehow and get that information...
strings.스스로 소멸을 선택하는 악마라…. 마족이니 의리나 충성심 따위는 없을 줄: A demon choosing to destroy himself... I thought demons had no loyalty or sense of duty, but I was wrong.
What should we do now? We still have so little information...
Wait a moment. Let me think of another approach.
strings.아, 다른 존재가 아직 신전 안에 남아있는 것 같은데…. 바포메트라고 하: Ah, I think another being is still inside the temple... A demon called Baphomet.
strings.바포메트? 그 자는 왜 아직 남아있는 걸까요?: Baphomet? Why would he still be here?
He's Blas's trusted subordinate. He may not have managed to escape yet.
strings.그 마족도 스스로 소멸을 선택하면 어떻게 하죠?: What if that demon chooses to destroy himself too?
strings.한 번 마주친 적이 있는데, 그렇지 않을 겁니다. 마지못해 이곳으로 나: I encountered him once. I don't think he will. He seemed reluctant to come here, so he'll surely look for a way to survive.
strings.마족은 본능적으로 자신보다 강한 자를 처리한 존재를 인식합니다. 모험가님: Demons instinctively recognize someone who has defeated a being stronger than themselves. He'll realize it as soon as you approach.
I see. Then I'll go meet Baphomet and talk to him.
...I couldn't believe you'd defeated Blas... But it was true...
strings.인간 중에 이런 실력을 가진 자는 많이 보지 못했어. 대체 너란 인간은…: I've seen very few humans with skills like these. What kind of human are you...?
strings.설마…. 누가 보냈냐?: Don't tell me... Who sent you?
Did Lux send you? Or another power from the demon realm...?
strings.마지 못해서 여기까지 나왔다는 걸 알고 있어. 그러니 적당히 대답하고,: I know you only came here reluctantly. Give us the answers we need and leave quietly.
We don't want much from you.
strings.저, 정말 살려줄거냐?: W-will you really let me live?
Yes. If you tell me everything you know, I'll ask them to show mercy.
strings.신전을 공격한 이유는 뭐지?: Why did you attack the temple?
strings.바로 힘이다. 럭스 님은 신의 힘이 필요했다. 뻔하지. 이 세계를 손에: Power. Lord Lux needed a god's power. It's obvious: he wants this world in his hands. That's why he's searching for the power of this world's gods.
strings.신의 힘으로 엮여 있는 모든 걸 손에 넣으려고 하시지. 특히 그 힘이 많: He intends to seize everything connected to divine power. The Temple of Seres is a place where an especially large amount of it remains.
...Surely you know that Seres, the God of the Astral Realm, vanished long ago.
I don't know much about that, but I heard a similar power was here.
strings.우리는 그 힘을 지닌 자를 찾아 럭스 님께 데려가려고 했다. 그러면 우리: We intended to find the one who possessed that power and take them to Lord Lux. That would have completed our mission...
But in the end, we couldn't find them. I suppose the god had no intention of giving us power.
strings.(비슷한 힘이 여기에 있다는 건….): (A similar power being here would mean...)
All right. You can go now.
strings.그리고 이곳에 다시 나타나지 마. 그거 하나만 약속해라. 그렇지 않는다면: And never show your face here again. Promise me that one thing. Otherwise...
strings.(말이 끝나기 무섭게 바포메트가 뒤도 돌아보지 않고 줄행랑친다.): (Before I can even finish speaking, Baphomet runs away without looking back.)
strings.오셨군요. 성과가 있었습니까?: You're back. Did you learn anything?
strings.(바포메트와 했던 대화를 전달받은 프레투스가 놀란 표정으로 바라본다.): (Pretus looks surprised as he hears about the conversation with Baphomet.)
I see. Perhaps the oracle... the oracle left by the goddess...
Now please tell me about that oracle.
strings.죄송합니다. 제 등급으로는 말씀드릴 수 없습니다. 티그리스 님을 찾아 지: I'm sorry. My rank doesn't permit me to discuss it. Please find Tigris and tell him what you've accomplished.
strings.그러면 모험가님께서 알고 싶어하는 내용을 알려 주실 것입니다. 다시 한번: Then he'll tell you what you want to know. Thank you again. I'll continue clearing this place and searching for survivors.
Adventurer... Oh, already gone. You looked disappointed...
You dealt so swiftly with the enemies who gave us such trouble...
strings.과연 듣던대로 훌륭한 실력을 가진 모험가답군!: You really are as capable an adventurer as I've heard!
Now, please tell me. You have a promise to keep.
strings.왠지 모르게 화가 난 것 같군. 약속대로 이리스 님이 왜 이곳에 있고,: You seem somehow angry. As promised, I'll tell you why Lady Iris was here, and where she went after the temple attack...
strings.(드디어 이리스를 만날 수 있는 건가….): (Will I finally be able to meet Iris...?)
strings.이리스 님은 1년 전에 이곳에 오셨네. 마왕과 싸우고 행방불명됐다 나타나: Lady Iris came here a year ago. After fighting the Demon King, she disappeared, then reappeared and came here through Riveria. She said Lady Seres had saved her and that she needed to meet her...
strings.우리는 이리스 님이 오시기만을 기다렸었어. 그 전에 마침 이리스 님을 보: We'd been waiting for Lady Iris to arrive. Just beforehand, we received an oracle telling us to protect her. I can't say which god sent it, but her arrival made us believe it.
strings.그동안 우리는 이리스 님을 보호하며 외부의 일원에게 알리지 않았네. 그건: All this time, we've protected Lady Iris without informing members outside the temple. I'm sorry about that. It was such a momentous matter...
strings.그동안 이리스 님은 잠드시고 오랫동안 깨어나지 않으셨네. 그러던 중, 갑: Lady Iris slept and did not wake for a long time. Then Lux's demon army suddenly attacked.
strings.우리는 이리스 님에게 최고의 호위를 붙여 멀리 벗어나시도록 했네. 그들이: We assigned our finest escorts to Lady Iris and sent her far away. What they wanted was clearly divine power...
Only then did we understand why the oracle had told us to protect her.
Lux intended to use Lady Seres's power to rule the world.
strings.자네가 생각하는 것이 맞네. 우리는 단순히 한 소녀를 지킨 것이 아니라: You're right. We weren't merely protecting a girl. We were protecting a goddess with a new destiny.
It's as hard for me to believe while telling you as it must be for you to hear.
strings.이리스 님이 시간에 맞춰 이곳에 온 것은 아마도 세레스 님의 인도. 세레: Lady Iris's timely arrival was probably Seres's guidance. While Iris slept, Seres seems to have given her the power residing in the temple.
strings.이리스 님은 그래서 인간의 몸으로 세레스 님의 뒤를 이은 신으로 선택되신: That is how Lady Iris, in a human body, was chosen as the god who would succeed Lady Seres.
strings.이리스 님은 많이 위험한 상태라네. 그 힘을 노리는 자들이 많거든. 그래: Lady Iris is in great danger. Many seek her power. That's why we had to assign escorts and get her away from here.
It's hard to believe, but Lady Iris told us that you experienced another world. Yggdrasil, she called it...
For now, Lord Belosh seems to have resolved that problem temporarily.
strings.그게 데미갓이 해결할 수 있는 일이었나요?: Was that something a Demigod could resolve?
He says he resolved it, so we have to trust him. He is an excellent Demigod of our temple.
So don't doubt him. Trust him as someone who is helping Lady Iris.
strings.데미갓은 고대신들께 받은 힘으로 빛을 쫓고, 어둠을 처단하지. 나머지는: Demigods pursue the light and destroy darkness with power received from the ancient gods. Everything else they accomplish through experience and effort.
strings.자네는 모르겠지만, 신전을 비롯해 많은 곳들이 불길한 공격을 받은 적이: You may not know this, but many places, including the temple, have suffered ominous attacks. We were able to hold out thanks to these Demigods.
So we have to trust the one escorting and serving Lady Iris...
If you're still doubtful, there's nothing I can do. Belosh is suspicious of you too.
strings.이리스 님께서 자네를 만날 수 있게 기다려달라고 했지만, 시간이 없다며: Lady Iris asked him to wait so she could meet you, but he said there was no time and urged her to leave...
So I was a little too late...
strings.괜찮아. 괜찮아. 때가 되면 이리스 님을 만날 수 있을 거야. 이리스 님: It's all right. It's all right. You'll meet Lady Iris when the time comes. She's looking forward to it too.
strings.지금 이리스 님은 데미갓을 따라 안전한 곳으로 가고 있을 거야. 자세한: She should be traveling with the Demigod to somewhere safe now. Ask Leo for the details.
Oh, already gone. I was going to thank you once more...
strings.이리스 님? 티그리스 님 말대로 데미갓과 함께…. 알았어, 알았어. 정확: Lady Iris? As Tigris said, she's with the Demigod... All right, all right. To be precise, she went to the eastern continent.
strings.동방 대륙이요? 동방 대륙이 어디에 있는 곳이죠?: The eastern continent? Where is that?
strings.프레이오스 동쪽에 있는 특별한 대륙이지. 그 중에 위대한 검신 지스카드: A special continent east of Freios. I heard she went to the great Sword God Ziskad there.
strings.프로즌 님께서 이리스 님을 호위하면서 안전한 곳을 떠올린 곳이 그곳이었어: While escorting Lady Iris, Frozen thought of it as a safe place. He said he had connections there from when he visited the East Land on business long ago.
Lord Ziskad gave his permission, so that's where they must have gone.
strings.왜 그곳으로 이동한 거죠? 정말 믿어도 괜찮은 건가요?: Why did they move there? Is it really safe to trust them?
strings.알았어, 알았어. 이야기 듣던대로 이리스 님을만나러 오는 사람이있다고 들: All right, all right. I'd heard someone was coming to meet Lady Iris, just like the stories said. I never thought it would really happen.
Lady Iris is incomplete right now. Please understand that.
strings.인간의 몸으로 신이 되려는 과정이 결코 쉽진 않을 거야. 지금 그 힘 때: Becoming a god in a human body cannot be easy. And now demons are attacking because of that power...
strings.그건 이리스 님께서 잘 하시겠지만…. 완벽해지려면 그게 얼마나 걸리실지: I'm sure she'll manage... but I don't know how long it will take her to become complete.
So she needs many people's help right now.
There will be no shortage of enemies targeting her...
strings.너 그래도 이리스 님을 만나러 갈거야? 언젠가 네가 그 적들을 다 상대해: Will you still go to see Lady Iris? Someday, you may have to face all those enemies.
So please tell me how to get to where Iris is.
strings.(역시 일반적인 인물과는 다르군. 이리스 님께서 말씀하신 대로야….): (Definitely not an ordinary person. Just as Lady Iris said...)
Oh, sorry. My mind wandered for a moment.
strings.그래, 좋아. 조금만 기다려. 준비되는 대로 그곳으로 갈 수 있게 해주지: All right, good. Wait a little. Once everything is ready, I'll make sure you can get there.
